name: David B. Goldberg
title: President, California Teachers Association
background: Goldberg earned a bachelor's degree in community studies from UC Santa Cruz and obtained his teaching credential through Los Angeles Unified School District's intern program; he briefly pursued professional basketball overseas before entering the classroom. An educator since 1997, he spent most of his teaching career as a bilingual teacher at Murchison Elementary in LAUSD and is fluent in Spanish and American Sign Language in addition to English. (Source: California Teachers Association, official biography.)

Before becoming CTA president, Goldberg served as CTA vice president for four years, CTA secretary-treasurer for four years, two three-year terms on the CTA Board of Directors, and as treasurer of United Teachers Los Angeles (UTLA). He was actively involved in UTLA's 2019 strike, continuing what CTA's biography describes as a family tradition: his mother served as a strike captain in the 1989 teachers' strike and his grandmother participated in the 1970 Los Angeles teachers' strike. He is now serving his second three-year term as CTA president, a term that CTA's biography states expires June 25, 2028. (Source: California Teachers Association, official biography.)

Goldberg is a co-proponent, alongside attorney Benjamin Gevercer, of Proposition 3 on the November 2026 California ballot, which deletes the scheduled 2031 expiration of the Proposition 30/Proposition 55 personal income tax surcharge on the state's top three tax brackets. Goldberg and Gevercer filed the initiative with the Attorney General on August 29, 2025 and were cleared to begin collecting petition signatures on November 4, 2025. CTA is the measure's sponsor and dominant funder, reporting $17,775,000 of the $19,025,000 raised by the Proposition 3 support committee through the June 30, 2026 filing period, and Goldberg signed the official ballot argument in favor. (Source: content/measures/ca-prop-3-2026.json in this voter guide; California Secretary of State initiative-circulation notice for the measure.)
